description: This file contains functions and interfaces related to managing and displaying contributor information for a GitHub repository, including fetching contributor data via GitHub API, sorting contributors, identifying bots, and generating markdown lists of contributors.

methods.name: getContributors
methods.description: Fetches the list of contributors from a GitHub repository using the provided token.

methods.name: sortContributors
methods.description: Sorts a list of contributors primarily by number of contributions, then by login name.

methods.name: generateMarkdownList
methods.description: Generates a markdown formatted list of contributors, marking bots with an emoji.

methods.name: constructContributorsContext
methods.description: Constructs a markdown string that introduces the list of contributors.
